prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity 1536×1024 landscape north-star desktop web app comp for a visual-direction decision
Primary request: Design CueBench’s complete evidence-led caption and audio-description workbench first viewport in the “Projection Proof” world. The video is a shared classroom transparency; an agent adds transparent timed marks and the teacher settles the record. This must unmistakably be an OPERATE surface, not a landing page, poster, or chatbot.
Structure: a very slim project/status rail across the top; a luminous video evidence field owning roughly the upper-left two thirds; directly beneath it one shared time ruler, waveform, caption cue spans, audio-description gap spans, and playhead; a narrow but fully readable numbered review docket on the right; a shallow collapsible Court Record drawer across the bottom. The selected cue must visibly connect the video, waveform span, docket item, and evidence finding. No marketing hero and no side chat.
Real product content: product name “CueBench”; project “Gibbs Free Energy — Lesson 4”; video frame of a teacher beside a scientific slide; selected cue “C05 · 00:12.400 → 00:15.100 · Dr. Nguyen explains Gibbs free energy.”; docket statuses Proposed, Objected, Sustained, Agent Ready; quality summary “2 blockers · 3 warnings”; finding “Name uncertainty: Dr. Nguyen”; human-only actions “Object” and “Sustain”; WebMCP state “Agent connected”; Court Record line “Agent revised C05 · You sustained C06”. Include a small clearly subordinate audio-description lane.
Visual world: cool chalk-white projector field, graphite type, restrained lab teal for active evidence, amendment violet, ochre warning, deep green Sustained. Translucent acetate layers with sparse registration marks and dry-erase annotation; only the selected evidence layer lifts, surrounding layers recede and stay still. Status banks must differ by label, shape, and color. A short visible focus trace may link a finding to its cue. Precise modern workhorse UI typography, not a stylized display font. High information density with generous alignment, calm daylight classroom legibility, WCAG-conscious contrast.
Constraints: show a complete coherent desktop application first viewport; all core regions visible; full caption prose must be readable in the docket; semantic familiar controls; no chat panel, no speech bubbles, no gavel, no judge imagery, no courtroom cosplay, no generic neon AI dashboard, no excessive glassmorphism, no marketing claims, no login, no giant empty header, no device frame, no watermark.
